headline: Big bye week: A.J. Brown, Golden, Price and Darnold are all off, and Willis is on IR, so add a QB (Rodgers or Cam Ward) and a WR (Flournoy) before waivers clear.
alerts: You have no healthy QB. Willis is on IR and Seattle is on bye. Claim Aaron Rodgers or Cam Ward on waivers.
Byes this week: New England (A.J. Brown), Green Bay (Golden), Seattle (Price, Darnold). Three starters are out.
Thursday 5:15 PM Pacific: Colts at Texans. Set Seth McGowan at RB and Spencer Shrader at K before then.
Hockenson (wrist, chest) is uncertain for Sunday 5:20 PM Pacific in Mexico City. Grab a backup TE like Chig Okonkwo if you have room.
This run could not open Sleeper or the ESPN API, so the roster is from last week's run and Week 10 points were not scored. Check your roster in Sleeper before acting.

IND.note: At Houston Thursday 5:15 PM Pacific. Texans -10.5, total 44.5, Colts about 17 implied. Set McGowan and Shrader before kickoff.

DET.note: Hosts Tampa Bay Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Lions -5.5, total 46.5, about 26 implied.

PIT.note: At Philadelphia Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Steelers -4.5, total 38.5, about 21.5 implied.

MIA.note: At Buffalo Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Bills -16.5, total 46.5, Miami about 15 implied.

NYJ.note: At the Chargers Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Chargers -3, total 40.5, Jets about 18.75 implied. Cross-country trip. Geno Smith ankle, Klubnik may start.

NYG.note: Hosts Jacksonville Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Jaguars -6.5, total 46.5, Giants about 20 implied.

MIN.note: At San Francisco in Mexico City Sunday 5:20 PM Pacific. 49ers -3, total 46.5, Vikings about 21.75 implied. Addison likely out, Hockenson uncertain.

WAS.note: Hosts Cincinnati Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. Bengals -4.5, total 51.5, Washington about 23.5 implied.

TEN.note: At Dallas Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Cowboys -7.5, total 53.5, the highest of the week. Titans about 23 implied.

8155.name: Breece Hall
notes: At the Chargers Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Chargers -3, total 40.5, Jets about 18.75 implied.
Week 10: 11 carries for 41 yards plus 4 catches for 67 yards vs Buffalo, about 16.8 PPR points. He out-touched Braelon Allen.
Geno Smith hurt his ankle and rookie Cade Klubnik finished the Bills game. A rookie QB should mean more checkdowns to Hall, which helps in PPR.

13424.name: Seth McGowan
notes: Plays Thursday at Houston 5:15 PM Pacific, so set him before then. Texans -10.5, total 44.5, Colts only about 17 implied.
Yahoo notes 77 yards and a TD on 12 opportunities last week and a TD in back-to-back games. He is still behind Jonathan Taylor, so it is TD-or-bust.
With Price on bye he is your best second RB option on the current roster.
